# The Mamdani Exit — NYC listing evaluator, taxes & cost-of-living (agent interface)

Verified 2026 US tax data (federal, state, NYC-specific). Static site — all computation is
client-side JavaScript; there is no backend. Amounts are USD per year unless noted. Not tax advice.

## Primary use: send a NYC listing, get the true cost of owning
Browser-driving agents — open this URL with the listing's facts; the page body becomes one JSON doc:
  https://meticulo3366.github.io/mamdani-exit/api.html?mode=listing&price=950000&type=coop&maintMo=2600&coopDedPct=60&gross=150000
Add &rentMo=4200 for the rent-vs-own verdict. Listing-speak accepted: type=co-op, status=married.
Returns: one-time NYC costs (mansion tax, recording tax — co-ops exempt), year-1 monthly cost
before/after tax savings (split: property deductions vs mortgage interest), true cost net of
principal, computed tax notes, and (with rentMo) breakEvenYear — null means owning never catches
renting within the horizon.

Code-executing agents — exact same answer without a browser:
  curl -O https://meticulo3366.github.io/mamdani-exit/engine.js   # CommonJS + browser global, no deps
  node -e "const E=require('./engine.js'); console.log(JSON.stringify(E.evaluateListing(
    {price:950000,type:'coop',maintMo:2600,coopDedPct:60,rentMo:4200},{gross:150000,status:'single'},null),null,2))"
(ESM project? run from a clean temp dir or use module.createRequire.)

## Other tools (same module / same API page)
- compareCities(inputs, null, ids?) / api.html?mode=cities&gross=150000&cities=nyc,miami,austin
  Ranks cities by disc = discretionary USD/yr after taxes + living costs; deltaVsBaseline is vs NYC
  (positive = better than NYC). Unknown ids error with the valid list.
- calcRvo(params, inputs, null) / api.html?mode=rvo&... — full year-by-year rent-vs-own detail
  (years[].year is 1-based; delta = owner wealth minus renter wealth if sold that year).
- api.html?mode=data or https://meticulo3366.github.io/mamdani-exit/data.json — every verified
  bracket/rate/rule for clients that cannot run JS (compute carefully: SALT cap interplay, NY
  recapture, Pub 936, §121 are the common mistakes; recipes in API.md).
Full parameter & output reference: https://meticulo3366.github.io/mamdani-exit/API.md

## MCP (Claude Desktop/Code, ChatGPT desktop, Cursor, ...)
Easiest: git clone https://github.com/meticulo3366/mamdani-exit (keeps the required layout:
mcp-server.js at the root, engine.js under src/ — a loose download also works with both files in
ONE directory). Register:
  { "mcpServers": { "mamdani-exit": { "command": "node", "args": ["<path>/mcp-server.js"] } } }
Tools: evaluate_listing (primary), compare_cities, rent_vs_own_nyc, get_tax_data.

Human UI: https://meticulo3366.github.io/mamdani-exit/
